user_saw: Running openclaw plugins update for the Codex plugin under a macOS Seatbelt profile that denies exec in ~/.openclaw failed with 'Failed to verify platform-specific npm dependencies ... EPERM: operation not permitted, access .../bin/codex'.
summary: Platform-package completeness now checks the vendored binary with fs.stat (regular file plus Unix exec bits) instead of fs.access(X_OK), so a sandbox that denies exec no longer aborts install.
reasoning: GraphQL blame puts the fs.access(X_OK) probe (EPERM not tolerated) in b68c13660904 (#128370, 2026-08-25), where it is equivalent to a mode-bit check on an ordinary host and worked for its intended use. It fails only when the user runs OpenClaw under a custom Seatbelt profile denying process-exec, which macOS evaluates for X_OK probes; that external sandbox usage was never promised, so latent with no in-repo trigger.
